description: Returns one certificate class by its 9-character CUSIP: its trust, coupon, original and current balance, principal paid, realized losses and credit support from the latest trustee report. Use it when the user gives a CUSIP; an ISIN, or a trust and a class such as "BANK 2019-BNK16 A-S", also works. Use get_trust to see all of a trust's classes. A CUSIP not on file returns found: false with the closest classes.

cusip.description: 9-character CUSIP, e.g. "08162UAS9"; an ISIN, or a trust and a class, also works

name: find_cusip

CertificateClass.description: One certificate (bond) class of a trust, from its latest trustee report.

beg.description: Class balance at the start of the period, dollars (notional for interest-only classes).

cs.description: Current credit support, in percent (71.19 = 71.19%): the share of the pool subordinate to the class.

csComputed.description: Present and true only when cs was computed by cmbs.news from class balances (Citibank reports); absent when the report printed cs.

csOrig.description: Original credit support at issuance, in percent (30 = 30%), as the Computershare report prints it.

cusip.description: The class's 9-character CUSIP; null when a Citibank report does not list one for the class.

end.description: Class balance after this distribution, dollars (notional for interest-only classes).

int.description: Interest distributed to the class this period, dollars.

io.description: True when the class name starts with X: an interest-only class whose balances are notional.

loss.description: Realized losses allocated to the class this period, dollars (Citibank: 'Realized Loss/(Recovery)', so a recovery is negative).

orig.description: Original class balance at issuance, dollars (notional for interest-only classes).

prepay.description: Prepayment penalties distributed to the class this period, dollars.

prin.description: Principal distributed to the class this period, dollars.

rate.description: Pass-through rate (coupon) for the period, in percent (1.559 = 1.559%), not a fraction.

total.description: Total distribution to the class this period, dollars.

outputSchema.description: Every field with its unit and codes, in full: https://cmbs.news/openapi.json (operation findCusip). Money in US dollars; a rate, occupancy or share is a fraction of 1 (0.0475 is 4.75%) unless it says percent; DSCR is a multiple; dates YYYY-MM-DD.

argumentNote.description: Sent when an argument was renamed, read in another form or left out because it could not be used: says which and how.

callsLeft.description: Without a key: calls left today on the free allowance, this one counted. Not sent with a Pro or Team key.

candidates.description: On a found: false answer: the closest real records, most likely first; empty when nothing is close.

items.description: One real record close to what was asked.

class.description: A certificate class: its class as the trust files it, e.g.

leftTheTrusts.description: A loan: true when it paid off or left the trusts, so its page shows its last figures.

slug.description: A loan: its slug, to pass to get_loan.

trust.description: A certificate class: the slug of its trust.

trustName.description: A certificate class: the name of its trust.

certificateClass.description: The certificate class with this CUSIP, from the trust's latest trustee report.

cusip.description: The CUSIP looked up, normalized to 9 upper-case characters.

distributionDate.description: Distribution date of the report the class figures come from (YYYY-MM-DD); null if not readable.

found.description: Present only when the cusip asked for is not on file: false.

keyNote.description: Sent when the key given was a placeholder (such as YOUR_KEY): the call was answered as a call without a key, and this says why.

matchNote.description: Present when the text sent was not an exact identifier but fit exactly one record: how it was read, so the caller can check it is the record meant.

message.description: Why, in words: what was asked, why nothing matched, and what to do.

nextCall.description: On a found: false answer: the exact call to make next, as {tool, arguments}. An argument written in <angle brackets> is a template to fill in.

trust.description: Slug (not the name) of the trust that issued the class.

trusteeReport.description: URL of that trustee report (10-D Exhibit 99.1) on SEC EDGAR.

title: Find a certificate by CUSIP
